correctness.rationale: For characteristic five degree-six Artin-Schreier y^5-y=x^6+u x^4+a x^3+b x^2+c x, one pole of order six gives genus10/p-rank0 and ten differential basis pairs 5i+6j<=18. Independently expanded all ten basis Cartier images into the polynomial entrywise-fifth-power matrix; found exactly 15 nonzero entries matching the full RESULT.md, including T=[[2a,2b+u^2],[-2u,-2a]] with determinant P=a^2-ub+2u^3. Columns 4,5,6 support row0; column9 supplies a linearly independent component from (b+u^2,a,u); rank is 2+rank T outside (u,a,b)=0, otherwise zero. Thus geometric rank4 if P!=0, 3 if P=0 off line, 0 on line; a-numbers 6,7,10. Every nonzero 4x4 minor is product P times one row0 generator and one column9 independent generator, yielding I4=P(u,a,b)^2 and embedded quotient R/(u,a,b)^2 of length4 transversely. Independent F5 rank census for all 125 u,a,b triples (c=3): 0:1,3:24,4:100. Matrix scheme is explicitly the entrywise fifth-power convention; no assertion about full Ekedahl-Oort type.
residual_risks: No finite computation establishes infinite-parameter coverage; the reconstructed algebraic proof supplies the stated general scope.
